name: oracle-clean-quoted
_why: The same compliant shape as oracle-clean, with the rebuild wrapped in `sh -c '...'` the way a real one is (sdk-ts has to probe for a wasm32 clang before it can call wasm-pack). The out-dir token then ends in the closing quote, and a gate that does not strip it resolves the oracle to `pkg'` and accuses this package of never rebuilding. That is the false positive this fixture exists to keep out.

scripts.build:oracle: sh -c 'if [ -z "$CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown" ]; then CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown=clang; export CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown; fi; exec wasm-pack build . --target nodejs --out-dir pkg'
